verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Restate's documentation, templates and plugin helping AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) build Restate apps. It does not document operating Restate itself, such as managing services, deployments or invocations, through natural-language commands. Operations are documented only through the CLI, HTTP, typed clients and the admin/introspection APIs, so the AI-assistant material is adjacent developer help, not natural-language operation of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
